text: FinCEN Advisory on structuring patterns near CTR thresholds.

31 U.S.C. § 5324(a)(3) prohibits structuring transactions to evade currency transaction reporting. Examiners should document patterns of sub-CTR deposits and counterparty concentration. Additional FinCEN commentary on SAR filing timelines.
